title: Cloud Cost Assurance
ogQuestion: Is cloud spend still inside the envelope the business agreed?
intent: Commercial: holding cloud cost against agreed thresholds with owned correction
brief: Cost is assured through allocation coverage, anomaly response time, commitment utilisation and waste age. Correction is owned to a verified change in spend. Absorbs cost anomaly and commitment topics.

title: Unit Economics Assurance
ogQuestion: What does one unit of business outcome cost today?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof of technology cost per unit of business outcome
brief: Unit cost moves with usage, pricing and architecture. Covers unit definition, allocation integrity, shared-cost treatment, margin thresholds and detection of unit-cost regression after release.

title: Data Freshness Assurance
ogQuestion: How old is the data behind today's decision?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that data arrives within the age the consuming outcome tolerates
brief: Freshness is defined by the consumer, not the pipeline schedule. Covers end-to-end data age, consumer-defined tolerance, silent staleness, and propagation into reports, decisions and AI retrieval.

title: Data Quality Assurance
ogQuestion: Is the data still fit for the decision that uses it?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that data meets the quality its consumers depend on
brief: Quality rules age as sources and semantics change. Covers rule coverage of critical fields, contract conformance, distribution shift, reconciliation and ownership of each failed expectation through to correction.

title: Data Pipeline Assurance
ogQuestion: Did every pipeline deliver complete data, on time, in order?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that pipelines deliver complete, timely, correct data and can recover
brief: A green run is not a correct delivery. Covers completeness, lateness, schema change handling, replay and backfill capability, and orchestration platform currency.

title: Release Assurance
ogQuestion: What does each release prove before it reaches customers?
intent: Commercial: release evidence and production validation held against thresholds
brief: A release is assured by evidence gathered before and after deployment. Covers gate validity, progressive exposure, post-deployment verification, provenance of what was shipped and change failure rate. Absorbs deployment and production validation topics.

title: Rollback Readiness Assurance
ogQuestion: Can the last change be reversed inside the time that matters?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that change can be reversed within an agreed time
brief: Rollback is a capability that silently disappears with irreversible migrations, state changes and dependency upgrades. Covers exercised rollback time, irreversible-change identification, data migration reversibility and rollback of models and configuration.
